basic_info.description: Settle into this refreshed 3BD/2BA gem where timeless character blends seamlessly with modern updates. Thoughtful upgrades including a new roof, fresh paint, updated siding, and much more - create a home that feels both beautifully renewed and reassuringly cared for. Natural light pours through a wide picture window in the living room, highlighting coved ceilings and a corner fireplace. Hardwood floors lead the way to the dining area and skylit kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite counters, and ample cabinetry. Down the hall, 2 bedrooms feature partial ocean views, while the hall bath offers floor-to-ceiling tile with shower-over-tub. The versatile lower level includes a bedroom, full bath, and flex space for guests, office, or gym. Outside, enjoy a low-maintenance yard and a convenient storage shed. A spacious 1-car garage with built-in cabinets and driveway parking completes the home. The revamped Stonestown Galleria provides a variety of shopping, dining, and entertainment, including a theater, Round 1, Target, TJ's, Whole Foods, and Sunday Farmers Market, while nearby Ocean Ave corridor and HMart add to the diverse selection. Close to several beautiful parks and gardens, offering something for everyone. Close to 19th Ave, HWY 280 & public transit. Welcome home!
